# FunkYouSHiFT

Official site: https://www.funkyoushift.com/
Preferred canonical domain: https://www.funkyoushift.com/
Current version: v3.2.0

FunkYouSHiFT is a Borderlands creator and Discord community hub. The site routes visitors to Discord, streams, videos, giveaways, merch, and useful Borderlands resources.

Important pages:
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/ — homepage and main routing hub
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/borderlands-discord.html — Borderlands Discord server page for BL3/BL4, trading, modded gear, builds, and help
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/discord.html — direct community conversion page
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/borderlands-modded-weapons.html — modded weapons and modded gear help page
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/borderlands-modding.html — Borderlands modding and modded item help
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/borderlands-trading.html — Borderlands trading, loot, and gear help
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/borderlands-builds.html — Borderlands builds and build help
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/borderlands-build-videos.html — curated build video resources
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/borderlands-resources.html — Lootlemon, MentalMars, BL4Hunt, videos, and resource links
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/video.html — streams, clips, and watch content
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/merch.html — FunkYouSHiFT merch through Streamlabs
- https://www.funkyoushift.com/giveaway.html — giveaway information

Primary topics:
Borderlands Discord, Borderlands 3 Discord, Borderlands 4 Discord, Borderlands trading Discord, Borderlands modding, Borderlands modded weapons, modded gear, Borderlands builds, giveaways, streams, Twitch, YouTube, Lootlemon, MentalMars, BL4Hunt.
